# Survey

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A read-only survey snapshot with Number, Valid, Path, AnswerFile and HasAccess(). For an accessible entry in Session.Conference.Surveys, QUEST Number runs the questionnaire.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#introduction-and-surveys-400).

## AnswerFile

`Survey.AnswerFile: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only zero-based Number, Valid flag, questionnaire Path or answer-file path AnswerFile. Valid means a configured entry, not existing files. QUEST Number uses the current session conference; add one to Number for the native S menu. No answers are read or changed by these properties.

## HasAccess

```PPL
Survey.HasAccess() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Checks the current session against this snapshot's conference and survey security rules. FALSE for an invalid entry. Call before QUEST Number for an entry in the current conference; does not check file existence or command-level permissions.
